claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Lobendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic with no annotated human target; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against human cancer cell lines, with any killing likely reflecting weak, non-specific antiproliferative effects rather than a defined mechanism.
